body.name: IH
body.def: \(\mathcal I_H=\{\xi\in\Lambda_H:g_H(\xi)=0,\ s_H^N(\xi)(s)>0\iff s\in H,\ o_H^N(\xi)(c)>0\text{ for every }c\in\mathcal C_H^{\mathrm{adm}}(G^+)\}\). This construction is intrinsic to the retained primitive coordinates and stored gate syntax and does not define \(\mathcal I_H\) as an image of \(\Theta_H\).
